sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.
Hon'ble Rajiv Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Surendra Singh-I,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned AGA for the State-respondents and perused the record.
2. The instant writ petition has been filed by the petitioners with the prayer to quash theFIR dated 21.06.2024 in Case Crime No.0228 of 2024, under Sections 498A, 304-B, 328 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Faijganjbehata, District Badaun.
Mohit And 3 Others vs State Of Up And 2 Others on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/21679154/
1

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that from the allegations made in the first information report, prima facie no offence, complained of, is disclosed against the petitioners and as such, the impugned first information report is liable to be quashed.

4. Per contra, learned AGA has submitted that from the allegations made in the first information report, prima facie offence is clearly disclosed against the petitioners, therefore, the impugned first information report can not be quashed in view of law laid down by the Hon'ble Apex Court in the case of State of Telangana Vs. Habib Abdullah Jellani reported in (2017) 2 SCC 779, Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in (2021) SCC Online SC 315 and in a recent decision of the Hon'ble Apex Court in Criminal Appeal No. 843 of 2024, Directorate Enforcement Vs. Niraj Tyagi and others.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Neeharika Infrastructure Pvt. Ltd. vs. State of Maharashtra and Others reported in (2021) SCC Online SC 315
entities.label: PRECEDENT

entities.text: Directorate Enforcement Vs. Niraj Tyagi and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. Having considered the rival submission made by learned counsel for the parties and taking into consideration the allegations made in the FIR and the relevant law cited by learned AGA and the fact that impugned first information report discloses cognizable offence against the petitioners, we are of the opinion that the impugned first information report can not be quashed.
6. The prayer for quashing the impugned first information report is therefore refused.

7. However in case, the petitioners move an application for anticipatory bail before the appropriate court, their bail applications shall be considered and disposed of as expeditiously as possible in accordance with law.
8. With the aforesaid observations, the instant writ petition is disposed of.
